items.title: Mining giant BHP to cut hundreds of jobs at iron ore mines
items.summary: Mining giant BHP confirms job cuts at its iron ore operations in Western Australia, which the ABC understands will mean 300 positions axed.

aus.headline: BHP Axes 300 Iron Ore Jobs
aus.body: BHP confirmed job cuts in its WA iron ore business, with about 300 roles to go.
aus.why: Hundreds of WA mining workers face losing their jobs.

us.headline: Nasdaq Falls 2% On CPI Shock
us.body: The Nasdaq sank 2% after a surprise US inflation report stirred rate hike fears.
us.why: US rate hike fears can ripple through global share markets.

biz.headline: BofA Shares Sink 8%
biz.body: Bank of America fell after a trading revenue miss and a $1.2b Treasury fine.
biz.why: A slide at a US banking giant can weigh on bank stocks worldwide.
